name: Heavy Dragonfly 92
author: Pradeepsaranbishnoi
description: Neon pill sky-blue radio button that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: text color changes from #000000 to #185ee0, background-color changes from #e6eef9 to #185ee0, text color changes from #000000 to #fff.
